words.defn_en: in addition; furthermore; apart from or in addition to someone or something:
words.root_note: be- (by) + side; literally, by the side of

sentences.en: The proposal is too expensive; ______, it would take years to complete.
sentences.zh: 這項提案費用過高；此外，還需要數年才能完成。

sentences.en: No one ______ the lead researcher had access to the confidential laboratory records.
sentences.zh: 除了首席研究員之外，沒有人能查閱機密實驗室紀錄。
